request_summary: Run all existing API test suites in the dev environment.

actions.description: Detected the missing behave executable and verified behave was absent from the active Python environment.
Installed requirements.txt successfully with python -m pip install -r requirements.txt.
Executed auth-service, cart, checkout-npg, and ecommerce-cdc with TARGET_ENV=dev and dedicated Allure result folders.
Collected scenario-level results and identified seven failing scenarios across the four suites.

outcome.detail: All four suites launched after dependency installation, but each suite had failing scenarios: auth-service 1, cart 1, checkout-npg 2, ecommerce-cdc 2. No suite fully passed.

notes: No code or feature files were modified. No active ACE playbook bullets.
friction: behave was initially unavailable and required installation from requirements.txt.
